SEIU Local 1000 represents about 100,000 workers employed in dozens of agencies across the state. They’re accountants, government analysts, nurses, IT workers, custodians and more. The union has been negotiating a new labor agreement since its contract expired on June 30, and is demanding better pay, more affordable healthcare coverage and more flexibility to work from home. CalHR, the state agency that handles state labor negotiations, said it “remains focused on achieving a fair and responsible agreement and continues to be available at the bargaining table.” With as many as 95,000 union members eligible to strike, you may experience some delays in government services.
